messages.content: My API integration is failing for enterprise accounts in EU region.
What error are you seeing?
Webhook delivery times out after 10 seconds.
Is authentication configured?
OAuth enabled.
Please confirm whether the endpoint is reachable from outside your network.
The endpoint is reachable and returns 200 for manual curl checks.
Please share whether failures affect all events or only some event types.
Failures mostly affect invoice.created and customer.updated events.
Please confirm if retry attempts eventually succeed.
Retries fail three times and then the event is marked failed.
Please check whether the timeout started after a recent deployment.
It started after we upgraded middleware last Friday.
Please confirm whether the same issue happens in the US region.
US region works correctly; only EU region is affected.
Please provide one failed request timestamp for investigation.
A failed request happened at 2026-05-21 09:14 UTC.
Please confirm if the payload size changed recently.
Payload size increased after adding custom metadata.
I will keep the EU enterprise webhook timeout context attached.
Please continue troubleshooting the webhook timeout issue.
